Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. The merge rules are one family per DOM object: each has an Apply* entry that walks the new objects through its mapping type (AreaMapping/LineMapping/SegmentMapping/FunctionMapping/TradeMapping/GroupRangeMapping), a Split*ByConflictState that produces the conflicting and the mapped buckets, an Add*ToBucket helper and a Report* that adds the conflict report's warning.
Method.resource strings: The reports carry the ETS resource names: CopyGroupRangeValidationFailed, LineWithDifferentMediumType, SegmentWithDifferentMediumType, DeviceMovedToUnassignedDevices and LinkGroupAddressNoTargetGroupAddress.
Method.predicates: HaveDifferentMediumType (LineConflictRule) compares the main segments' medium type names, HaveSameLength (UserFileConflictRule) compares the user files' lengths, and DeviceConflictRule.CopyCertificateIfSecureEnabled transfers the certificate of a secure device.
